releaseNotes.notes:
### Hardcore Mode
- New: Hardcore Mode checkbox when you create a character. Die once and the character is no longer Hardcore.
- Hardcore characters share their own gold, mastery and bank, apart from your regular characters. Hardcore Ironman characters keep their own, like Ironman.
- When a Hardcore character dies, the You Have Fallen screen shows their record. Lay to Rest sends them to the Graveyard, Keep Playing keeps them as a regular character with their gear and mastery.
- New: Graveyard at character select lists your fallen characters and how they died.
- Closing the game or losing connection mid-fight leaves your character in the fight for 15 sec. Dying in that time counts.
- Ending the game's server mid-run (Task Manager, power cut) counts as a death.
- Hardcore characters can't play co-op yet.

### Characters
- You can now have several characters of the same class. Class headers at character select fold open into that class's characters, with Hardcore and Ironman badges. Up to 50 characters.
- Mastery, talents, presets and Mythic bests now belong to each character.

### Transmog
- New: Esmeralda Glimmerstitch <Transmogrifier> at the Inn. Every gear piece you equip, loot or salvage adds its look to your account-wide collection, and so do the current items in your bags and bank.
- Pick a look for each slot around a live model of your character. Looks you haven't collected show greyed out, can be tried on in the Dressing Room, and their tooltip says where they drop.
- Hide your helm, shoulders or cloak.
- Save up to 5 outfits per character.
- Molten Core, Zul'Gurub and Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj runs drop their own epic looks.
- The Loot window marks looks you haven't collected yet.
- Durgan Ironbelly sells a Blank Tabard (Accessories). Tabard looks: Darkmoon Tabard from Sayge (30 tickets), Stormwind from For the King (clear Heroic 5), Flame from Heart of the Mountain (clear Molten Core), Frost from Winter's Edge (clear Mythic 20), and rare boss drops: Scarlet Crusade (Western Plaguelands), Argent Dawn (Eastern Plaguelands) and Arathor (Arathi Highlands).
- Controller: LB/RB turn the pages.

### Leaderboard
- Regular and Hardcore leaderboards, each with Solo and 2, 3 and 4 player tabs.
- Hardcore entries show Fell (keeps its place), Revived (restored from a backup, not ranked) or Unverified (runs missing from the leaderboard, not ranked).
- When your best clear is held by the season climb, the leaderboard says which level to clear next.
- Moving your game with a backup keeps your season climb. Clears above Mythic 40 are still sent with run data off, as long as you're shown on the leaderboard.

### Co-op
- Loot bags roll rarity for each player, and everyone sees their own beam colour.
- Party members can enchant at the host's Enchanter after a stage.
- Everyone rolls their own tabard drops.

### Warrior
- Bloodthirst: +38% damage, and 50% more while Enraged.
- Execute: +43% damage.
- Revenge: each enemy in reach adds 2% of your max health to your Shield, up to 6% per swing.
- Thunder Clap: +43% damage. Shield Slam: +36% damage.
- Rend and Blood Pool apply 4 Bleed (was 3). Deep Wounds applies 3 Bleed (was 2).

### Paladin
- Consecration: +67% damage. Standing in your Consecration heals 0.25% max health per sec (Blessed Ground 0.75%).
- Consecration and Blessed Ground last 12 sec on an 8 sec cooldown and stack up to 4 at once. Hallowed Ground lasts 18 sec, up to 5.
- Retribution Aura deals double damage to enemies standing in your Consecration.
- Seal of the Templar and Seal of Vengeance: -10% damage.

### Hunter
- Aimed Shot and Steady Aim: +40% damage.
- Chain Detonation: +40% damage, explosions deal 56% (was 40%).
- Trick Shots: +30% damage.
- Serpent Spread: +83% damage and applies 3 Poison.
- Viper Trap clouds last 6 sec (was 4). Venom Burst: +50% damage and leaves a 3 sec cloud.
- Explosive Trap: +5% explosion damage per Poison stack.
- Stampede: -10% damage.

### Rogue
- Envenom: +40% damage. Fan of Knives: +50% damage. Killing Spree: +50% damage.
- Mutilate on an enemy with 10+ Poison cuts 0.5 sec off Envenom's cooldown, once per cast.
- Find Weakness: -10% damage.

### Priest
- Mind Flay: +40% damage. Flaying an enemy with 10+ Decay heals you for 0.2% max health.
- Halo, Divine Hymn: +50% damage. Light's Edge: +45% damage. Shackle: +40% damage.
- Fixed: Holy Word: Chastise's cooldown on the action bar now drops when Smite, Halo or Light of the Naaru shortens it.

### Shaman
- Earth Shock: +50% damage. Flame Shock: +33% damage (evolutions +38%).
- Windfury Weapon: +33% damage. Stormstrike: +25% damage.
- Totem of Wrath and Aftershock: -10% damage.

### Mage
- Arcane Missiles deals 50% more to elites, mini-bosses and bosses.
- Blizzard: +50% damage. Frozen enemies inside Deep Freeze take 30% more Frost damage.
- Fireball: +33% damage. Flamestrike: +30% damage.

### Warlock
- Hellfire: +150% damage and applies 2 Burning.
- Shadow Bolt: +20% damage, and scales with Decay or Burning, whichever is higher.
- Rain of Fire and Rain of Chaos: +50% damage.
- Curse of Agony applies 1 more Agony. Drain Life: +38% damage.
- Voidwalker and Succubus: +50% damage. Felhunter: +25% damage. Summon Infernal: +50% damage.
- Fel Imps and Imp Swarm: -15% damage. Plague Beast and Dark Harvest: -5% damage.

### Druid
- Hurricane: +50% damage. Thrash: +75% damage.
- Swipe: +30% damage, plus 10% per Bleed stack on the target (up to 100%).
- Rejuvenation: +50% damage. Tranquility deals double damage.

### Interface
- Run Master: a value too long for its row moves below the stat name instead of overlapping it.
- The Extraction Vault widens to fit 3 and 4 slots.
- Innkeeper sliders save however you move them. Controllers can reroll Glyphs.

### Launcher
- Downloads that stall retry, pick up where they stopped (even after closing the launcher), and switch to the download mirror.
- If the game doesn't open within a minute on Vulkan, the launcher restarts it on DirectX 12 and remembers that.
- Fixed: The game's server sometimes wouldn't start after the PC shut down mid-game.
- Fixed: A full disk showed up as a connection problem.

### Fixes
- Fixed: The stage portal could spawn inside trees, rocks and rubble.
- Fixed: Boss void zones and pools stayed on the ground after the stage ended.
- Fixed: Run enchants still showed on item tooltips and the character panel after the run.
- Fixed: The leaderboard note under Start Run was missing on Mythic.
- Fixed: An error at character select.

### Hotfix 1
- NPC names switch right away when you change the game language, no relog needed.
- Leaderboard: when a Mythic clear won't be listed, the game now tells you why: Game Master character, legacy gear or gear above the level (with the item named), a group member's gear or Game Master account, or a climb level you still need to clear.
- Leaderboard: your gear is checked when you clear, not when the run starts.
- Anti-cheat: if a trainer or cheat tool changes the game while it's running, your clears no longer count for the leaderboard until you restart the game, and you're told why.
- Fixed: The launcher could crash when Windows blocked its restart or the database tool, when Show in folder couldn't find a file, when stopping the server, or when reopening its window after closing it.
- Simplified Chinese for everything new in 0.6.3, plus the rest of the Options page (by xenoglossy-asyncio).

### Zones
- 12 new zones: Normal: Loch Modan, Darkshore, Redridge Mountains and Silverpine Forest. Heroic: Hillsbrad Foothills, Thousand Needles, Dustwallow Marsh and Wetlands. Mythic: Winterspring, Azshara, Blasted Lands and Silithus.
- Normal and Heroic zones are now available in Mythic difficulty.
- Enemies, chests and power-ups no longer spawn in lava, slime or deep water. The treasure goblin, kobold thieves and kodo caravan path around lava and slime.
- Standing in lava or slime for 3 sec puts you back on solid ground.

### Bosses and Enemies
- Boss rework: bosses and mini-bosses use one big ability about every 16 sec and a smaller one about every 6 sec, faster on Heroic and Mythic. Other bosses hold their abilities while a big one is active.
- Boss abilities are larger. New abilities: Meteor Shower, Ring and Sweep.
- Bosses, mini-bosses, elites and bounties have more health. (Will be adjusted if needed)
- Enemy hits are capped at a share of your max health based on the enemy type. Each difficulty adds more enemy damage (No more oneshots).
- Elites, mini-bosses and bosses walk through regular enemies instead of getting body-blocked. They still collide with each other.

### Progression
- Alts unlock Mythic levels up to 10 below your account's best clear, talent points included. Ironman characters keep their own progress.
- On those levels the last stage has a Summoning Stone to spawn the boss. The Run Master shows it under the level dropdown.
- Epic, legendary and reward chances increase a little at Mythic 11 then every 10 levels after.
- Leaderboard season climb: clears up to Mythic 40 always count. Above 40, each level needs the one below it cleared this season. The Run Master warns you when a level skips the climb.
- The launcher loads the leaderboard from the download mirror when the stats server can't be reached.

### Rewards and Shops
- New at Sayge: Rewritten Fate (2 ranks), +1 Glyph reroll per run. The Glyph choice has a Reroll button (R).
- Darkmoon Card: Blue Dragon now grants 30% Haste and is Unique (limit 1).
- Darkmoon Tickets fly to you once you're in Pickup Range, like experience orbs.
- Valor chests, free chests and Valor pouches now glow. Free chests from elites and bosses get their own purple minimap icon.
- Rank-ups that add nothing no longer show up as offers.
- Shop requirements you don't meet show in red, and locked nodes are greyed out.
- Vault compare shows your own saved piece with its item level and stats, and the piece you're wearing shows as Currently Equipped.

### Classes
- Range Ring: Alt-click a spell on your action bar to show its range around your character. Set color, fill and opacity with the Range Ring button at Innkeeper Tarn Oakhoof.

#### Warrior
- Fixed: Rend's Bleed only applied from Cleave, not from Whirlwind and Thunder Clap.

#### Mage
- Flamestrike, Firewalk and Burning Ground now apply 4 stacks of Burning and leave a fire patch for 4 sec that burns enemies standing in it.
- Meteor and Flamestrike no longer leave lava on the ground.

#### Priest
- Vampiric Embrace healing cap doubled to 0.6% max health per second per rank.
- Inner Focus: each Penance kill now reduces its cooldown by 0.5 sec instead of resetting it.
- Rapture, Atonement Shield and Holy Word: Sanctify nerfed.

#### Hunter
- Stampede: charge hits reduced to 70% of a pet hit (was 100%).
- Pack Hunter: reduced to +2% Power per pet (was 3%).
- Bestial Wrath: penalty to your other spells increased to 25% (was 15%).

### Co-op
- New Party Damage meter above the damage meter: party total plus each player's damage and share.
- The host's Dark Fortunes apply to the whole group. Guests see them greyed out at Sayge.
- Party frames moved below Darkmoon Cards and Ley Lines.
- A failed join now tells you why.
- Fixed: Guests lost their gear's item level and stats on the host and after returning to solo.
- Fixed: Guests' extracted gear didn't arrive in their mailbox in the host's game.

### Interface
- New option: Pause on Rewards. Turn it off to keep a solo run going while you pick level-up, chest and Glyph rewards. Reward Card Scale sets how big those cards are.
- Wording pass on the whole game: Option and button names, shorter tooltips, spell and codex text matched to what spells actually do.
- The tutorial's first Innkeeper visit points you to Range Ring.
- Simplified Chinese for everything new in 0.6.1 and 0.6.2 (by xenoglossy-asyncio).
- Fixed: Characters didn't show on the character screen with non-English clients.
- Fixed: Berserking and other power-ups showed as debuffs.

### Hotfix 2
- The portal after the final stage now offers "Finish the run" first and "Continue in endless mode" second. Continuing asks you to confirm first: endless mode gives no extra rewards, and enemies and bosses spawn faster and faster until you die.
- Fixed: Gear bought from Durgan Ironbelly and the gear new characters start with could be marked as legacy, which kept your runs off the leaderboard. Pieces that are already marked stay legacy; replace them.
- Co-op: when you can't reach a host, the message now says the problem is the host's router, and that you can host the game yourself if your port is forwarded.

### Hotfix 1
- Fixed: The game stopped with "SetText(): Font not set" on clients without the game's standard font files.

### Classes
- When a burning, bleeding or poisoned enemy dies, the damage its stacks had left bursts onto up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, half on each.
- New passives: Pyromaniac (+10% Burning damage) and Serrated Blades (+10% Bleed damage), offered to classes with Burning or Bleed spells.
- Character stats show your Burning and Bleed damage.
- Fixed: Small damage over time ticks lost part of their percent bonuses (Toxicology, spell ranks and talents) to rounding.

#### Warrior
- Rend: your Cleave, Whirlwind and Thunder Clap hits also apply 1 stack of Bleed.
- Deep Wounds: your critical strike chance against a bleeding enemy is increased by 1% per stack of Bleed, up to 20%.
- Mortal Strike: bleeding enemies it hits also take the damage their Bleed would deal over the next 2 sec, keeping their stacks.

#### Paladin
- Avenger's Shield replaces Hammer of Wrath. It hurls a holy shield that jumps to 4 more enemies, and each hit counts as a Paladin strike. New evolutions: Grand Crusader and Shield of the Righteous.
- Seal of Righteousness: every hit from your other Paladin spells, splash and area hits included, deals 30% extra as Holy damage.
- Seal of Command: every 2nd strike from your other Paladin spells releases a burst of light.
- Divine Storm: each enemy hit counts as a strike for Seal of Command.
- The Art of War damage retuned.

#### Hunter
- Viper Trap replaces Frost Trap. It releases 4 vipers that rush the nearest enemies and burst into poison clouds. Evolutions: Corrosive Vipers and Venom Burst.
- Volatile Trap replaces Snake Trap. It explodes, burns the ground, and explodes again 2 sec later for 60% damage.
- Trap talents (Clever Traps, Entrapment, Trap Mastery, Lingering Venom) now work on Viper Trap.
- Pack Leader: your pets mark the enemies they bite with Hunter's Mark.
- Volley: every 25 enemies it hits loads an Explosive Arrow into your Aimed Shot, up to 2.
- Fixed: Sprung trap models could keep looping after the stage or run ended.

#### Rogue
- Deadly Poison also throws a vial at the largest group of enemies, applying 4 stacks of Poison.
- Mutilate applies 1 more stack of Poison for every 5 stacks the enemy already has.
- Envenom strikes the 3 enemies with the most Poison for all the damage their Poison would still deal, keeping their stacks.
- Eviscerate: a kill carries the blow to the next enemy within 8 yards, up to 3 times.
- Killing Spree: each strike reduces the cooldown of Eviscerate by 0.5 sec.

#### Priest
- Mind Flay deals 5% more per stack of Decay on the target.
- Renew: with Power Word: Shield, healing past full health tops up your Shield.

#### Shaman
- Maelstrom Weapon: every 3rd hit from your other Shaman spells hurls a free Lightning Bolt.
- Lightning Shield zaps 1 enemy for each charge you hold every 1.5 sec, and each zap gives you a Shield.
- Earth Shock: each Static stack it consumes restores 1 Lightning Shield charge.
- Stormstrike counts as 2 hits for Maelstrom Weapon.
- Earth Shock and Stormstrike deal more damage.

#### Mage
- Blink: enemies near where you land gain 2 stacks of Chill, and Frost Nova is ready again.
- Meteor's crater no longer leaves a patch of burning ground behind.

#### Warlock
- Hellfire applies 1 stack of Burning.
- Shadow Bolt deals 4% more per stack of Decay on the target.
- Curse of Agony: your Shadow Bolts add 1 stack of Agony to cursed enemies.
- Drain Life: drained enemies take 20% more damage from your Decay and Agony.

#### Druid
- Thorns: enemies that strike you also gain 2 stacks of Moonfire.
- Rejuvenation: healing past full health makes your spells attack 15% more often for 3 sec.

### Co-op
- Ironman characters can now play co-op. Their gold and progress stay separate from the rest of your account.
- Joining shows that your request is being sent, and you can cancel it or the character transfer.
- Co-op games end cleanly for party members when the host closes the game, the host's PC crashes, the lobby is down for a while or a launcher crashes. Party members leave with a message, and rewards earned up to that point arrive exactly once.
- If the lobby restarts, hosted games are listed again with the same code.
- Changes to the host's settings apply from the next run without restarting the game.
- Party members cannot use the bank feature in co-op.
- Co-op problems are written to the launcher log, so bug reports include them.
- Fixed: Joining could get stuck on "The launcher didn't answer", with your character shown in the host's game while you stayed at the menu.
- Fixed: After a co-op game ended, the launcher could keep refusing to let you enter your own game until it was restarted.
- Fixed: Items in your own mailbox could be taken twice by taking them in someone else's game.
- Fixed: Kicking a guest who was offline didn't end their session.
- Fixed: A guest who lost connection still counted as standing, could be picked as the reviver and held up the party at portals.

### Leaderboard
- Each list shows the top 1000. Your personal best is always shown, ranked 1000+ when it is below that.
- Your runs are only uploaded when they would place on the ladder.
- The leaderboard shows when it last synced, and says when syncing failed.
- Run Master says under 'Start' whether the chosen level counts for the leaderboard, and names the worn item that keeps it disabled.
- Fixed: Tiered gear without a Season 1 record kept runs off the leaderboard without being marked Legacy.
- Fixed: Uploads and the leaderboard failed on some connections.
- Fixed: Copying the game folder to another PC made both PCs share one leaderboard identity.

### Fixes
- Fixed: The character screen showed English class names on Chinese clients.

### Hotfix 1
- Items in the Extraction Vault now reach the guest's mailbox, also when the guest leaves or closes the game in the middle of a run.
- Leaving a game no longer blocks your class when you try to join it again.
- Gold, items and progress earned as a guest no longer go missing now and then.
- If the host leaves in the middle of a run, the guests' runs end with it instead of getting stuck on the stage.
- When the host closes the game, guests still get the rewards from their last moments.
- A guest's Summoning Stone now summons the boss for the whole party, and the portal opens for everyone. Before, only the guest saw the portal, stopped attacking and couldn't change floors.
- Everyone in the party sees the boss summoning countdown.
- Cancelling a join just as the host accepts no longer locks your character until the launcher restarts.
- A guest changing floors is no longer dropped from the party when someone else joins.
- Guests who leave are removed from the host's game properly.
- Players on the same VPN, such as Radmin VPN, Hamachi, ZeroTier or Tailscale, now connect to each other automatically, and you can host over a VPN.
- Video settings have a Resolution option. Automatic fills your screen as before. Pick a size to play in a window of that size; on Steam Deck it is stretched to fill the screen.
- Fixed rare launcher crashes when closing the game, when clicking the tray icon after closing the window, and when updating while an old copy of the launcher was still open.

### Co-op
- **A note on Co-op: It is entirely self-hosted the host's own PC and everyone else connects straight to it. There is no central game server. The lobby only lists games and passes on join requests, and none of your game traffic goes through it.**
- More players can host without touching their router. When outside players can't reach the host directly, the two launchers now connect to each other through the routers on their own (UDP hole punching).
- Players on the same network as the host can always join, with no port forwarding. Those games show a LAN badge in the browser and are only listed for players on that network.
- Hosts can enter a Public Address, for ZeroTier, Tailscale, a tunnel or a port forward to a different port. Games on ZeroTier or Tailscale addresses can only be joined with the invite code.
- If nobody can reach you, the message now says what to do: forward TCP port 3725 to your PC and allow the launcher through Windows Firewall.
- Hosts on internet connections with IPv6 no longer fail the "can others reach you" check.
- A downed teammate's skull and bleed-out countdown now sit to the right of their health bar on the party frame, where you can read them.

### Fixes
- Fixed: Returning from a co-op game could crash your own game server if you had used the season board.
- Fixed: Packs of flyers could keep spawning around a downed player, or a teammate standing next to them, and glitch around.
- Fixed: The launcher could crash when the game closed.
- Fixed: The launcher could crash when opening a link (Discord, Report bug) on some PCs.

### Simplified Chinese
- Character select, character create, the class preview, the co-op lobby, the new gear names and the rest of 0.6.0's text, by xenoglossy-asyncio.

### Co-op
- **There will most likely be bugs, please report them. Hard to test co-op locally on one machine**
- Play with up to 3 friends: party size 2 to 4 (for now), picked by the host. The host creates a lobby from the character screen and others browse it and ask to join.
- The lobby browser has a Filters menu. Hosts can set a minimum Mythic level for join requests, allow duplicate classes, choose pausing and XP, and change those settings later at Corin Bannerfield in the Inn.
- Your own character, gold, bank, gear and progress go along. Everything you earn as a guest comes home, including level records, finale pay, upgrades and epic bad luck protection.
- If your connection drops you rejoin automatically, and after a restart you're offered Rejoin.
- Every member gets their own vault around the portal, marked Yours.
- More players bring more bosses: 2 with 2-3 players, 3 with 4, each with more health. Enemy crowds grow up to twice the size, with more health each.
- Kills reward the killer, and the group gets loot bags where each member loots their own item.
- XP, healing turkey legs and power-ups can be picked up by anyone.
- Pausing is shared, with a 20 second timer to pick a card. Without pausing, level-up cards, glyphs and loot show small above the action bar and you keep playing while they're up.
- When you go down you get a red beam and a ring on the ground. A teammate who stands in the ring revives you, and the ring keeps its progress if they step out.
- The party shares a revive pool. Downed players show a skull and their countdown on the party frames.
- If nobody revives you in time, you will spectate a teammate. With 3 or more players, arrows above the action bar switch who you watch.
- Dead players follow through the portal with the party and keep spectating. Each new stage's revive gives them another chance, and anyone still dead gets back up when the final boss dies.
- Any living player can use the portal, and everyone else gets a ready check.
- Time of day and weather are synced for everyone.
- Other players' spell effects can be turned down in Video > Graphics, under Spell Detail Level.
- Alliance and Horde can talk and group together.
- Ironman characters play solo only.

### Mythic levels
- Levels replace floors: Normal 1-4, Heroic 1-5 and Mythic 1 and up, each picked from a dropdown above Start run.
- Runs are shorter: Normal is 1 stage, Heroic 2 and Mythic 3.
- Normal and Heroic levels are easier and Mythic 1-10 ramps more smoothly.
- Mythic has no hard limit. Past Mythic 30 enemies grow much faster.
- Personal bests for each level: clears, first clear, fastest clear, top damage, most kills, gold and valor per minute, and endless.
- Shop ranks unlock by cleared level. Pack Mule needs Mythic 15, the 5th spell slot Mythic 5 and the 6th passive slot Mythic 10. Upgrade prices were reworked. (not final)
- Darkmoon Favors have a maximum. Other sinks will be added.

### Endless finale
- After stage 3 you can carry on in the same map with the clock running.
- A boss comes every 9 minutes, 10% sooner each time (never under 3 minutes). Mini-bosses come at half that.
- Enemy health and damage keep growing every 10 minutes.
- Your score counts finale time only.

### Gear
- Item Level replaces tiers. Gear level follows the run's level with no cap. (more game modes later)
- New gear families with collectible looks. Epics look like Molten Core, Blackwing Lair, Ahn'Qiraj and Naxxramas gear at Mythic 1, 10, 20 and 30.
- Every piece can be upgraded 3 times at Durgan, which is now the one gear shop.
- Durgan's stock and upgrade limit follow each character's own best clear.
- Epic bad luck protection on Mythic levels: each gear drop that isn't epic raises the next epic's chance by 5% until one drops. The Run Master shows the current bonus.
- The Hearthstone sends one piece home, it no longer ends your run.
- The Extraction Vault gets a slot for each cleared stage.
- The Run Master's drop preview shows the item level range each quality can drop at.

### Leaderboard Season 1
- A Leaderboard sign at the Inn opens solo and 2, 3 and 4 player boards, with a class filter and a pinned row for your best.
- You choose in game whether to be shown on the board.
- Gear from before the season is marked legacy. It works as before, but a run with legacy gear doesn't go on the board.

### Shrines
- The Summoning Stone appears at the start of every stage except the last, and its boss opens the next stage.
- Other shrines pop up at random times during a stage, and every 1:30-3:00 in endless.

### Dungeons, invasions and raids
- Dungeons and invasions now both give 25% more gold.
- Mini-bosses drop gear twice as often in dungeons and 50% more often in invasions.
- Hogger and Old Murk-Eye count as full mini-bosses, and their hidden spots sparkle until found.

### Classes
- Shaman totems get their own spots, Magma Totem is thrown at the pack, and Lightning Shield zaps on its own.
- Totems left behind are dropped fresh where you are instead of teleporting.
- Moonkin Wrath and totem bolts deal their damage when the bolt arrives.
- Drain Life, Drain Soul and Dark Pact heal 1% of maximum health per drained enemy each second (was 0.2%).
- Glyph of Corpse Explosion deals exactly 40% of the dead enemy's health, no longer scaled by Power or crit.
- Glyph of Cleave carries leftover damage into the next enemy the same way against normal mobs, elites and bosses.
- Mythic base movement speed is +5%, 10% in Normal and Heroic.

### Interface
- The damage meter lists every damage source: Static, other keywords, procs and melee. Static shows as its own part of the spell that applied it.
- The character stats panel shows live bonuses from cards, glyphs, buffs and talents, and updates every second when the panel is open.
- Level-up buttons show their key on the button.
- Several bosses at once show several boss bars.

### Launcher
- If GitHub can't be reached, the launcher downloads from a mirror.
- The launcher moves the database to another port when Windows won't let it use 3306, and remembers the choice.
- Update button is disabled while the launcher updates itself.
- Windows stability fixes in the game client.

### Fixes
- Fixed: Hail of Bolts, Relentless and Volley quests didn't count bolts and shots, and counted AoE spells.
- Fixed: Shrines and events could spawn out of bounds at a zone's edge.
- Fixed: Drain Life didn't heal characters under 500 maximum health, so Dark Pact couldn't trigger.
- Fixed: The tutorial's "Spend your gold" step pointed at the Talent Trainer, which moved downstairs.
- Fixed: Release spirit no longer pops up (co-op).
- Fixed: Enemies could take damage from DoTs, pets and procs while the run was paused.
- Fixed: Bosses kited far from where the fight started could run back home at full health.
- Fixed: Dropped totems and hydras slid or popped before settling.

### Hotfix 3
- Pet cone and pounce attacks like Swipe, Cleave and Prowl count toward the pet's spell damage instead of adding extra damage that Count multiplied.
- Thunderfury, Sulfuras, Corrupted Ashbringer and Maelstrom deal their % of the single hit. Count no longer multiplies them.
- Reach now extends class melee strikes like Sinister Strike and Eviscerate to the range the tooltip shows.
- Pickup range stops being offered when you have 400%.
- Loot tooltips show the correct stats of the offered tier.
- The Extraction pillar shows each sent piece's real tier.
- Ossirian's sand waves use dust clouds instead of tornadoes.
- The launcher switches the game to DirectX 12 after a crash in the Vulkan driver and tells you.
- The launcher no longer crashes when it closes.
- The launcher's status details wrap under their own line instead of running behind the buttons.

### Hotfix 2
- The Codex groups spells and evolutions by specialization, with a divider between each one.
- The Talent Trainer now stands next to the Spellbook Keeper.
- Warlock imps from Imp Swarm, Infernals and the Doomguard stop attacking while you pick a level-up card.
- HD creature patches no longer stop the game from starting.
- The launcher trims server logs that grow past 32 MB when the server stops.
- Simplified Chinese for the new 0.5.2 text, thanks to xenoglossy-asyncio.

### Hotfix 1
- Auto-pick no longer ends the run on checkpoints with many extra level-ups.
- Single Darkmoon Favors refunds work again instead of needing Refund all.
- Rank-up cards no longer show a false "(at cap)" on Burning and other per-stack damage.

- Blood Aura, Aegis and Spiked Shield reach ~~6~~ → **8** yards.

- Halo also hits enemies right next to you, pulses every ~~5~~ → **4** sec and heals up to ~~5%~~ → **2%** of your health.

- Penance +30% damage, Mind Blast +20%.

#### Rogue

- Killing Spree shows a slash on every enemy it hits.
- Shuriken Toss throws ~~2~~ → **3** shurikens, +25% damage.

#### Shaman

- Chain Lightning and Forked Lightning jump to ~~3~~ → **4** enemies. Chain Lightning every ~~2.5~~ → **3** sec, +70% damage.
- Flame Shock and Earth Shock +50% damage. Windfury Weapon, Stormstrike and Magma Totem +33%.

- Monster paths now come as a download instead of being built on your processor. Installs and updates fetch them in a few minutes (about 330 MB), with no more long wait at 100% CPU. If your launcher already finished building them, there's nothing extra to download.
- If the download doesn't work, the launcher builds them on your PC like before. It first asks whether to use all of your processor cores or half, so your PC stays usable, and you can change that later from the ••• menu next to Play.
- Building monster paths now runs at a lower priority, so the rest of your PC stays responsive.

The first public version. It's early, so here's what to expect.

- Balance hasn't had much work yet. Some classes, spells and builds are bound to be too strong or too weak, and some zones are harder than they should be. Tell us what feels off.
- Six classes are playable. Druid, Paladin and Warlock come in later updates.
- Expect bugs. If something breaks, use Report a bug in the launcher: it saves a zip of your logs on your desktop to attach, or post it in the Discord.
- The first install takes a while, because the launcher builds the monster paths from your own game files. The harder zones keep building in the background while you play.
- Updates come through the launcher. Your characters are backed up before every update and your unlocks stay.
